usedFor: SprintOps holds tasks and sprints, and Dropbox saves a file from a web link through “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new task is created” in SprintOps, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each new task can bring its reference file into a Dropbox folder, saved from a public link.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” lets you choose how to handle existing files, so set that before task events repeat.
